extraction.verdict_en: The renewed Citroen C3 offers a competitive price and improved ride comfort, but material quality and noise insulation fall short of expectations. The mild hybrid powertrain is good, but the dual-clutch gearbox shows some shortcomings. Overall, it is a worthwhile purchase for those seeking a basic supermini with clear pros and cons.
